items.title: Donating MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary: Anthropic is donating the Model Context Protocol to the Linux Foundation's new Agentic AI Foundation, co-founded with Block and OpenAI.

items.title: Accenture and Anthropic launch partnership
items.summary: A multi-year partnership creates the Accenture Anthropic Business Group, with 30,000 professionals trained on Claude to move enterprises to production.
